hardening.minimized_reason: Disables Brotli/Zstd HTTP compression, terminal admin console, URL previews, io_uring, Sentry and OpenTelemetry. Retains RocksDB storage codecs and pure-Rust Brotli for embedded static assets.
hardening.pledge_reason: No package-enforced pledge-style capability policy is claimed; service confinement is tracked in Werewolf forms.

changes.what: Builds pinned Continuwuity with Wolfi tools. Omits optional HTTP codecs, terminal console, URL previews, io_uring and telemetry; preserves RocksDB codecs and embedded static asset support. Repairs shared OIDC media imports when URL previews are disabled.
changes.why: Provide an independently maintained application context with immutable sources and separately updatable Wolfi dependencies.

wolfi.removal_condition: Wolfi provides equivalent packaging, supported versions, architectures and required hardening; review compatibility before retiring this context.
